findings.status: viewpoint/idiom adjudication candidate; not yet integrated
findings.finding: Distinguishing colours can describe perceptual ability or an active comparison. Bare sto distinguendo i due colori is plausible in active analysis but would benefit from an explicit process situation; do not claim universally invalid progressive.

findings.status: background scenario clarity candidate; not yet integrated
findings.finding: Used to emigrate to another country permits repeated migrations, but a single emigration episode would need was emigrating. Current indefinite-frame habit is not declared categorically false without a clearer authored situation.

formalLessonForms returns both c’è entrato and c’è entrata under ci clitic, so an explicit female formal-address form question may accept masculine agreement. Need source-specific ci relevance subject/agreement review and precise prior form-question capture, not a global clitic exception change.

Esagerare con i complimenti/con le critiche means overdo compliments/criticism; generated exaggerate with the compliments is an English-shaped frame and the declared exaggerate a point sense does not fit all frames. Preserve Italian core forms and exact old cues when refining selected English predicates.

findings.status: definite English adverb ordering and selected time-viewpoint repair candidate
findings.finding: Generated exists today still / existed today still is unnatural ordering; selected background La specie esisteva ancora oggi also needs an explicit past viewpoint. Current ordinary temporal frames should be differentiated by chapter with old pool preservation.
Usage equates both evita! (singular you: avoid it/don’t) and evitiamo! (let’s avoid it) with let’s not. Distinguish addressee vs inclusive-we meaning; current actual core paradigm forms are correct.

findings.status: teaching composition clarification candidate, not incorrect dictionary answer
findings.finding: The dictionary masculine-singular participle prompt correctly accepts fatto. Compound teaching should explicitly distinguish the fixed ce l’ho fatta construction from the dictionary base participle; do not retire the valid dictionary answer.

The entry can cover starting a relationship and engagement, whereas the selected English get engaged narrows the meaning. Clarify the engagement sense and broader usage rather than categorically rejecting the existing core forms.
Current intentional trusting can support a progressive reading. A context should distinguish an ongoing trust decision from a standing attitude; no claim that every fidarsi progressive is invalid.

Reserve frame di essere sorpreso is reused for explicit female ordinary/formal and plural subjects. All seven present reserve contexts were read; ordinary person2,3,4,5 and formal person2 have incompatible singular masculine sorpreso. Preserve exact prior pools, retire only invalid old contexts, and use a neutral or person-specific replacement.
The conventional 753 BCE Rome foundation statement should be qualified as traditional chronology if retained as an factual model; primary historical source is needed before editing.

The count form a behaviour can occur in technical use but is awkward in the ordinary generated judgement scenario. Prefer an ordinary action/behaviour context if revised; no categorical grammatical error claimed.
Usage says Italians use fare un colloquio, not intervistare, for job interviews. Everyday preference should not exclude legitimate technical intervista di selezione uses without source review.
Ran over may add detail beyond hit in the collision example. The verb can legitimately have run-over meaning, so review the exact selected context before changing translation.
Always with a is stronger than the common selected course enrolment pattern; uses with nelle liste/nell’albo require primary review before qualifying the note. Core forms unchanged.
The English WITH in the preposition note can mislead learners because complain to someone is the intended addressee reading. Actual complaint-to-manager frames are correctly translated.

findings.status: definite per-frame English collocation repair candidate
findings.finding: Frame la promessa should use keep the promise rather than maintain the promise. The other composure/pace/balance frames do fit maintain; preserve the exact prior per-frame cues before replacing only the promise translation.

findings.status: primary-supported bounded accepted-variant teaching candidate; not yet integrated
findings.finding: Treccani confirms mento is currently more frequent and mentisco is an accepted alternate only in present indicative/subjunctive/imperative at 1/2/3 singular and 3 plural. Current usage should specify that bounded mode/person scope; exact valid alternatives can be added without replacing mento. PONS directly attests the rendered present participle mentente, so no invented mentiente replacement.

Both auxiliaries are supported for transitive improvement versus intransitive getting better. Direct-object selected frames use avere, while bare forms remain broad reference; do not blanket-retire otherwise valid intransitive forms.
Noticing a singular mistake can be a developing perception or an endpoint. Explicit ongoing inspection would make the progressive teaching clearer; no universally invalid-progressive claim.

The comparative claim that offendersi is more common than transitive offendere needs actual corpus evidence. The printed examples and finite forms are coherent; no categorical source-language correction claimed.
Always partecipare a fits the selected taking-part sense but should not be generalized to every historical/transitive sharing/disclosing sense without primary review.

Broad avere/essere arrays are legitimate transitive/intransitive forms; the selected direct-object worsening frames use avere. Bare generic form drills are not yet a meaning-specific auxiliary assessment.

The standalone pattern pensarci qualcuno is unclear as an infinitive regency model. If intended to show who takes care of it, use a finite subject-bearing model such as ci pensa qualcuno or ci penso io; the three stored Italian examples are coherent.

Broad avere/essere paradigms preserve legitimate action/progress uses. Current task frames and bare forms do not establish meaning-specific auxiliary assessment; no blanket retirement of prior forms is proposed.
The selected sense label give an attempt to a task is awkward; try a task or give it a try is clearer. The stored idiom examples and printed simple/progressive contexts match their intended meanings.

findings.status: definite selected-frame English collocation repair candidate
findings.finding: The declared cause-a-reaction sense includes un incidente, but the English predicate provoke produces provoke an accident; ordinary English uses cause an accident. Review the exact per-frame generated wording and preserve old cues before replacing the affected English predicate.

Realise can mean bring into reality in British English, so realise a project is not categorically false. The documentary/building frames would be clearer as make/produce/build in ordinary teaching English, with a per-frame predicate rather than conflating become aware.

findings.status: selected-sense morphology check coherent within read scope
findings.finding: Printed thinking compounds correctly filter to riflettuto; broad nonfinite reference preserves riflesso for optical reflection. This is a supported sense distinction, not a new repair or proof of every generated context.

Simple-only concern contexts and selected inanimate subject are coherent. Stored past ho riguardato i conti uses looking again; its finite form remains correct generic lemma practice, but should not be reported as a meaning-specific concern-only compound example.

Solve a problem/mystery fits the intended sense; resolve a dispute or fix/resolve an error is clearer ordinary English for the other frames. This is a per-frame idiom candidate, not a demonstrated Italian form error.

The background English I believed the proposal is valid leaves an unmotivated current-truth reading; I considered the proposal valid directly matches the Italian past assessment. Non-backshift can be legitimate, so no blanket grammar error or automatic retirement is declared.

Singular I gather in the square is awkward without expressed companions; meet or an explicit group/with-others situation is clearer. Italian can rely on contextual partners, so do not restrict persons or retire all coherent older social contexts.

Non rovinarti gli occhi leggendo al buio presents the dim-light damage myth as a neutral admonition. NEI and AAO distinguish temporary fatigue from eye damage. Replace the factual model with a neutral damage context after exact teaching/question scope and saved-source preservation are established; retain valid conjugation history.

Chocolate heated in a bain-marie is melted; dissolve may be possible in a different chocolate-and-liquid context. The generic frame would benefit from an explicitly heating-specific model/translation, rather than declaring dissolve universally impossible.
